metadata.title: Vintage Soul Beach Romance Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A vintage 1970s soul album aesthetic featuring a romantic couple on a beach with distinctive upward-slanted script typography in the upper left corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, sun-drenched photograph of a couple sitting on a wet sandy beach, framed by a diagonal shoreline and topped with two-tone, upward-slanted display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between dark male clothing and white mesh female clothing
Typography following the upward trajectory of the beach line
Warm sand reflections mirroring the subjects
coreInvariants: Upward-slanted typography in the top-left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Couple centered in the lower two-thirds, with the woman's back to the camera and the man looking toward her.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's white mesh dress provides a bright focal point against the sand.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left text, down the diagonal of the shore to the couple, and then to the reflections in the wet sand.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky and water in the upper right provides breathing room for the composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (sand and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue and black (water and male shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, yellow-tinted mid-tone range typical of aged film.

letterConstructionRules: Upward baseline tilt of approximately 15 degrees
Heavy vertical strokes with thin connectors
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a heavy script with a secondary line in a similar weight but different color.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative weight and curves
Matches the heavy, groovy soul aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1970s film photograph of a Black couple on a beach. The woman wears a white mesh dress, back to camera; the man sits facing her in a dark shirt. The shoreline runs diagonally from bottom left to top right. Muted warm tones and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold, high-contrast script text in the top left corner, slanted upwards at 15 degrees. The first line should be dark blue and the second line warm tan.
